description: Duskmaw v2 - the shadow figure (artist 2026-09-25: Aku / Father (KND) / Darkrai; 'red around its chest/leg mouth piece to show its a mouth that it devours you with'). Near-black violet body sinking into a darker shadow base, the eyes as the face, a blood-red lip framing the chest/skirt maw, ember teeth and a glowing throat; spike tips only smoulder. v1's shipped palette (body 41,38,43 / maroon roots / orange flame tips) is in git history.

body.note: near-black violet shadow body, hat, arms

base.note: the shadow rising out of the ground - darker still, the build darkens it further toward the floor (BASE_DARK)

tips.note: smouldering spike tips (arms, hands, hat) - dim so the maw and eyes lead

lip.note: blood-red lip framing the mouth opening (chest underside edge + skirt rim)

maw_inner.note: inner mouth: chest underside, floor, teeth insides - dark red

maw_throat.note: the glowing throat: back wall + throat column

teeth.note: ember teeth (upper points of the chest, lower peaks of the skirt)

eyes.note: Father-style hot glowing slit eyes - the face's only feature

grin.note: variant-only mouth on the face: painted as the body here (the head stays mouthless)
